scope: Two synthetic host-Mesa controls, source-cell SVG prototype through public SVG-to-PDF transport; 321x228 at 1x. No production BrushPen dispatch or device parity.
metric: Support is any RGB channel more than 2 away from background 252; IoU and RGB mean absolute error use union support. Native premultiplied RGBA is composited on 252. Long native is a crop with zero outside.
limitations: Removing coverage or all three masks while retaining the filter triggers resvg 0.47.0 composite dimension assertion in both controls; no measurements were produced for those variants.
Ablations alter the image and do not isolate a single transport defect; removing grain is not an admitted fix.

PDF rendering used PDFium through pypdfium2 at scale 4/3 for 1x pixel output. The script and builder are retained under ignored tmp and rely on local artifacts; the executable is an existing prebuilt helper, not a reproducible build receipt.
